name: Namer
description: Namer is a web app, watchdog service, and command-line tool for renaming and tagging adult video files using ThePornDB metadata, with a wizard-first setup flow for NAS-backed Proxmox LXC deployments.

notes.text: The first login flow is completed through the web setup wizard on port 6980.
This setup is designed for NAS-backed media paths, with NFS as the preferred storage mode.
For Proxmox deployments, prefer a host-mounted and bind-mounted NAS path; the wizard's in-container NFS probe can fail even when the final mount layout is correct.
Have your ThePornDB API token and NAS share details ready before starting the wizard.
This fork tracks the current setup-wizard validation flow and may differ from the upstream community-scripts catalog.

This fork uses a release-based default for Namer installs and updates. By default, ProxmoxVED installs the published `namer` package and checks for newer released package versions before updating. `NAMER_PIP_SPEC` is reserved for explicit tag or branch override tests. This intentionally differs from the usual ProxmoxVED GitHub-release helper pattern because Namer is currently managed here as a Python package-first integration.
